name: pickup_box_with_gripper
prerequisites: Robot must have a functional gripper capable of grasping the box.
The box should be within the operational range of the robot.
The environment around the box should be free of obstacles that could impede the robot's movement or access.
constraints: Ensure the gripper does not apply excessive force that could damage the box.
Maintain stability of the robot during the lifting process to avoid dropping the box.
